title: HistoricalPriceArchiveSchema
description: Schema for the persistent historical daily close price archive. Stores 18+ months of daily closing prices per equity, enabling accurate market_price_at_announcement lookups for any past trading date without relying on fragile reverse-engineering or fallback-to-current-price logic.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol of the public equity.

daily_closes.description: Map of YYYY-MM-DD date strings to closing prices in USD. Each key is a trading day; weekends and market holidays are omitted.

^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.description: Closing price on this trading day in USD.

first_date.description: Earliest date with a closing price in this archive entry.

last_date.description: Most recent date with a closing price in this archive entry.

total_trading_days.description: Total number of trading days stored in the daily_closes map.

as_of_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this archive entry was last updated.

provenance_source.description: Authoritative feed or API endpoint name.
